what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 1 of 3: A streaming clause whose second-order term is isotropic. SETTING (block 51; open PR titled 'ail51: the wind of a capturing body is not isotropic'; it corrects blocks 45 to 48): inertial record gas, sphere menu: a record of content s (a unit vector) steps to x + sign(s_k) e_k at the rate |s_k|/sqrt 3; occupied targets exchange contents; bonds re-draw their two contents on the momentum class at rate gamma; bodies are solid sites that capture the records stepping onto them. ESTABLISHED: the streaming operator to second order is (1/sqrt 3)[-s.grad + (1/2) sum_k |s_k| d_k^2]; sphere moments <|s_k|> = 1/2, <s_i^2 |s_i|> = 1/4, <s_i^2 |s_k|> = 1/8; so in local equilibrium at small density the momentum equation has the viscous term nu_lat (Laplacian g_i + d_i^2 g_i), nu_lat = sqrt3/16 (no sum over i in the last term: cubic symmetry, same coefficient as the isotropic part), and the number equation D_lat Laplacian n, D_lat = 1/(4 sqrt3); acting on a potential flow the cubic part is not a gradient, so the potential inflow does not solve the creeping equations; with the viscous operator nu (Laplacian g_i + eta d_i^2 g_i) the creeping inflow towards a sink is g_i(k) = -i k_i P/(k^2 + eta k_i^2), P = S/sum_i k_i^2/(k^2 + eta k_i^2): homogeneous, so the inflow is f(direction)/r^2 at every distance, with circulation. EXECUTED (one capturing body of about 22 sites, r from 6 to 10, inflow per unit capture along axes / face diagonals / body diagonals): 0.180, 0.143, 0.116 without scattering at density 0.1 (exact first-order values times 1/(1 - rho): 0.176, 0.147, 0.122); 0.175, 0.149, 0.130 at density 0.1, gamma 2; 0.223, 0.186, 0.172 at density 0.3, gamma 1 (isotropic closure 0.153 and 0.197); the creeping solution has the ratio axes/body diagonals 1.18, 1.37, 1.76 at eta = 1/4, 1/2, 1 in that shell. The forces between two capturing bodies in blocks 45 and 47 were executed ALONG A LATTICE AXIS ONLY.
